CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Thursday, January 20, 2022
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
Jesse Alvarado, Council Member
Myra Maravilla, Council Member  Luis Roa, Mayor  Ernesto Marquez,City Manager
Maria Teresa Del Rio, Council Member  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Special City Council meeting was called to order on Thursday, January 20, 2022 at 6:07 PM

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant II, provided brief information relating to the conduct of the meeting.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan
  Mayor Roa
  Councilmember Alvarado
  Councilmember Maravilla
  Councilmember Del Rio
ABSENT
  None

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant II, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  BUDGET WORKSHOP

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Conduct Budget Workshop.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, led the discussion of the budget workshop. He gave a brief
  summary regarding the overview of the Strategic Planning Goals & Objectives, City Council Goals,
  and the Budget.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, gave a summary regarding the overview of the budget being
  presented.

   Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, led the discussion of the budget workshop. He gave a brief
  summary regarding the overview of the Strategic Planning Goals & Objectives, City Council Goals,
  and the Budget.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, gave a summary regarding the overview of the budget being
  presented.

  Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, gave a brief summary regarding the
  programs and services in recreation.

  Councilmember Maravilla made comments regarding remodeling the facility and upgrading
  technology for Clarkdale and Leeware.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, stated they can create a fund to look at those requested projects
  for Clarkdale and Leeware.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, continued to give a summary regarding the City’s project list.

  Councilmember Maravilla made comments regarding the replacement of street signs and the
  possibility of using the Gas Tax to use as funding.

  Councilmember Farfan made comments of the consideration of renaming all the streets that have
  numbers and replacing them with street names.

  Mayor Roa would like to make this a goal and rename the numbered streets and invest some
  money into the project.

  Councilmember Maravilla made comments regarding speed bumps and traffic calming measures
  in the city.

  City Council agreed to researching more options to prevent speeding and dedicating funds to the
  topic.

  Councilmember Maravilla made comments regarding replacing the chain link fence by Helen
  Rosas with a block wall and Council will research further.

  Councilmember Alvarado made comments regarding building a second story for Public Works
  building. Staff will research for new estimated cost for project.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, continued to present the PowerPoint to Council.

ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

There were no Oral Council Reports.

ADJOURNMENT

City Council adjourned the Special meeting at 8:00 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be
held on Tuesday, January 25, 2022 at 6:00 PM.
